definitions.explanation: A feeling of calm and emotional ease. The noun form derived from the verb 安らぐ (to feel at ease). Describes the soothing quality of a place, person, or experience.

examples.japanese: {心|こころ}の{安|やす}らぎを{求|もと}める。
この{公園|こうえん}は{都会|とかい}の{中|なか}で{安|やす}らぎを{与|あた}えてくれる。
examples.english: This park provides a sense of tranquility in the middle of the city.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}と{過|す}ごす{時間|じかん}が、{一番|いちばん}の{安|やす}らぎだ。
examples.english: Time spent with family is the greatest source of comfort.

notes:
USAGE:
Derived from the verb {安|やす}らぐ (to feel at ease). Frequently used in advertising and lifestyle contexts to evoke a sense of relaxation and emotional peace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}の{安|やす}らぎ: peace of mind
- {安|やす}らぎを{感|かん}じる: to feel tranquility
- {安|やす}らぎを{与|あた}える: to give comfort
- {安|やす}らぎの{空間|くうかん}: a tranquil space

SIMILAR WORDS:
{癒|いや}し emphasizes healing or recovery from stress, while {安|やす}らぎ focuses on the calm, settled feeling itself.
